empty.connect: Connect calendar in Activities › Reminders and sync →
empty.choose: Choose a meeting on the left.

autoJoin.all: Auto-join: every meeting with a link

autoJoinHint.external: The default: meetings with only colleagues are never recorded
autoJoinHint.all: Internal meetings too — recording colleagues needs an objective reason and their information beforehand
autoJoinHint.off: The notetaker never joins on its own

capture.autoJoinTitle: When the notetaker joins your meetings
capture.autoJoinNote: The choice applies to meetings from your calendar; a meeting's own choice wins.
capture.autoJoinNoteOff: Your choice is saved. The meeting bot is not connected, so no bot joins any meeting until it is.

bot.d: Joins Google Meet, Zoom or Microsoft Teams from the calendar as a visible participant and records.
bot.notConnected: Not connected · no bot joins a meeting until a meeting bot provider is connected

desktop.d: Records the computer’s audio with no bot in the call — VoIP, phone and in-person meetings.
desktop.status: Not available yet · the desktop app is decided with meeting intelligence

adhoc.d: Start an ad hoc recording from the desktop app when there is no calendar event.
adhoc.s: Linked afterwards to a deal or person
adhoc.status: Needs the desktop app, which is not available yet

upload.d: Upload a transcript from a call recorded elsewhere to get the same recap and suggestions.
upload.status: File storage is not connected yet · uploads wait for it

header.linkedHidden: Linked to a record you cannot see

notice.blocked: The notice could not be sent · the bot stays out
notice.off: No notice email · the bot is still visible in the call
notice.noneNotConnected: Nothing records this meeting · the meeting bot is not connected

link.none: The meeting is not linked to anything yet.
link.hint: A linked meeting appears in the record's history as a meeting activity, and its recap can be saved there.

upload.title: A transcript from a call recorded elsewhere
upload.body: An uploaded transcript is read into the meeting with its speakers and times. The original file is deleted once it has been read.
upload.formatsHint: Up to 5 MB · WebVTT voices, SRT timings, «Name: text» lines or Word paragraphs
upload.notConnected: File storage is not connected yet, so no file can be sent. Nothing is created until it is.

brief.noChanges: Nothing has changed on the linked records.
brief.noChangesSince: Nothing has changed since the last contact on {date}.
brief.noFacts: No deal or organization facts to show.
brief.noFactsUnlinked: Link the meeting to a deal, lead, person or organization to see its facts.

none.title: No brief yet
none.body: A brief is built from the records 24 hours before the meeting and refreshed an hour before.
none.unlinked: This meeting has no link and no guest from outside, so a brief has nothing to draw on.

quotes.requested: Being found in earlier transcripts and notes …
quotes.failed: Could not be prepared this time.

change.other: A change on a linked record

none.upcoming: The transcript appears here after the meeting, when it is recorded or a transcript is uploaded.
none.notConnected: Nothing recorded this meeting: the meeting bot and the desktop app are not available yet.
none.upload: A transcript of a call recorded elsewhere can be uploaded once file storage is connected.

recap.title: Recap
recap.savedToast: Recap saved as a note on the {entity}
recap.saveNeedsLink: Link the meeting to a record to save the recap there.
recap.aiNotConnected: The AI provider is not connected, so a recap cannot be regenerated and a follow-up cannot be drafted.
recap.waiting: The recap follows when the transcript is ready.
recap.notConnected: Not available — AI not connected. The transcript stays readable.
recap.failed: The recap could not be made this time.
recap.draftNotConnected: Drafting a follow-up email is not available yet: it needs the email writer and a connected mailbox.

plan.hint: The activity is linked like the meeting: its deal, lead, person and organization.

speakers.title: Speakers
speakers.unmapped: Not mapped · shown as written in the file
speakers.hint: Map each label to a colleague or a guest, so the transcript names them and the brief can quote them.

suggest.title: Proposed CRM updates from the call
suggest.footer: Nothing is written without your approval · changelog source: meeting intelligence
suggest.written: {n, plural, one {# update written} other {# updates written}} · changelog source: meeting intelligence
suggest.staleToast: {n, plural, one {The record changed since the proposal; nothing was written} other {# records changed since the proposal; nothing was written}}
suggest.failedToast: {n, plural, one {A rule refused the update} other {Rules refused # updates}}
suggest.staleNow: The record changed since this was proposed. Accepting marks it stale and writes nothing.
suggest.staleDone: The record had changed, so nothing was overwritten.
suggest.failedContactRule: The contact rule allows new contacts only with opt-in.

empty.noTranscript: Suggestions come from the recap of a transcript, and this meeting has none.
empty.notConnected: The AI provider is not connected, so no suggestions are made from the transcript.
empty.none: The recap proposed no changes to the records.

consent.title: Recording and consent
consent.objectionSaved: Objection recorded · the bot stays out
consent.rules: Fixed rules: the notetaker's name says it records, it posts an opt-out link when it joins, and the owner can remove it at once. It never joins when a guest has opted out, or when a required notice could not be sent.
consent.botNotConnected: The meeting bot is not connected.

bot.scheduled: Joins about two minutes before the start
bot.in_call: In the call, as a visible participant

reason.notice_not_sent: the notice to guests could not be sent
reason.not_connected: the meeting bot is not connected
reason.other: a recording rule was not met

notice.blocked: Could not be sent · the bot stays out
notice.notRequired: Not needed: nothing records this meeting
notice.notRequiredNoGuests: Not needed: no guests from outside, or notices are off

recording.upload: No recording · the transcript was uploaded

objection.body: Record that this guest objects to being recorded (art. 21). The notetaker will not join this meeting, and leaves at once if it is in the call.
objection.always: Never record this address in any meeting
objection.note: Only a hash of the address is kept for «never». An objection does not delete a recording already made: use «Stop and delete recording» for that.

delete.bodyRecording: The audio is deleted from storage now. If the bot is in the call it leaves.
delete.bodyTranscript: The transcript, its recap and its suggestions are deleted, and quotes from it leave every brief.
delete.withTranscript: Also delete the transcript, its recap and its suggestions
delete.note: A recap already saved as a note stays on its record. This cannot be undone.

controls.firewall: The notetaker joins as a visible participant. Transcripts are CRM data only — survey content is never part of a brief, recap or AI context.

adminOnly.title: Workspace and controls
adminOnly.body: The per-user switch, the recording notice and how long audio is kept are set by an administrator (global «Configure»). Your own choices are beside this.

users.title: Meeting workspace per user
users.hint: On by default · one permission covers all features
users.none: No staff member has the deals permission.

notice.title: Recording consent notices to attendees
notice.hours: Hours before the start (0 = as soon as the meeting is known)

custom.s: e.g. 48 hours or at invite time
custom.current: {n, plural, =0 {As soon as the meeting is known} one {# hour before the start} other {# hours before the start}}

off.s: No notice email — the bot is still visible in the call

preview.title: What guests receive
preview.subject: Recording notice: [meeting] on [date]
preview.body: [Organiser] at [company] will record [meeting] with a notetaker that joins the call as a visible participant marked «(recording)». The recording becomes a transcript and a summary in our customer records. This email goes out {timing}. The audio is kept {retention}; the transcript stays with our records of the conversation. You can say no with the link below — for this meeting, or for every meeting with your address — and the notetaker will not join. [Opt-out link]
preview.off: No notice email is sent. Guests learn of the recording from the notetaker in the call, whose name says it records and which posts an opt-out link when it joins.
preview.hoursBefore: {n, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} before the meeting
preview.whenKnown: as soon as the meeting is known
preview.months: for {n, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}
preview.emailConnected: The notice goes out through the transactional email stream; if it cannot be sent, the bot stays out.
preview.emailNotConnected: The email provider is not connected, so no notice can go out: a meeting that needs one keeps the bot out.

retention.title: How long audio is kept
retention.note: Audio only. Transcripts stay with the meeting as long as its linked records do.

keep.s: Until a recording is deleted by hand

mine.title: My settings

external.s: The default: meetings with only colleagues are never recorded

all.s: Internal meetings too — colleagues must be told beforehand

mine.mailboxNotConnected: {address} is not connected, so briefs hold no email items yet.
mine.mailboxNone: No mailbox: briefs hold no email items.
mine.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Keep it short; always mention open tickets
mine.instructionsNote: Passed to the AI step of the brief only (the quotes). The AI provider is not connected yet.
